test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Just bite the ______ and tell him the truth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bullet**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**bite the bullet**" means to face a difficult or unpleasant situation with courage.
 
• This idiom originated from the old practice of having someone bite on a bullet to endure pain during surgery.
 
• The other options: "**gun**," "**dust**," and "**shot**" do not fit the context of the phrase.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Just bite the bullet__ and tell him the truth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bullet**: The small metallic projectile for firearms, used here metaphorically.
 
• **Gun**: Refers to a firearm, but not used in this phrase.
 
• **Dust**: Means particles of earth or a metaphor for mortality, not applicable here.
 
• **Shot**: Refers to the firing of a gun, also not fitting here.
